description: CICCHINI / STATE SENATE / ENOUGH (Official political campaign hat of Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate District 9) The logo that launched a historic campaign for State Senate in Michigan! Independents embrace ALL colors on the spectrum, and this hat reflects the commitment to include and represent everyone. This structured mid-profile trucker cap carries the campaign's message across the front panels—painted in distressed blue-white-red lettering that reads with clear, unapologetic voice. The hard buckram front keeps the shape crisp while the breathable mesh back and precurved Permacurv® visor make it an everyday go-to for sunny outings, rallies, or running errands. It settles comfortably on adult heads with an adjustable plastic snap closure and a soft cotton sweatband that keeps you cool and steady during long days outside. The contrasting undervisor and visor stitching add a finished, intentional look. Wear it to make your support of Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate visible from the front porch to the park. Product features - Structured six-panel, mid-profile design with hard buckram front - Precurved Permacurv® visor with matching undervisor and eight-row stitching - Breathable 100% polyester mesh back with adjustable plastic snap closure - Front and visor fabric: 60% cotton / 40% polyester; 100% cotton sweatband for comfort - Brand sticker on visor and sewn-in Yupoong label; complies with lead, bisphenols and phthalates requirements Care instructions - Use warm water and dish soap and clean spots off your hat. It's not necessary to soak the whole item. For hard to clean spots use a soft bristled brush. Paid for by Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate, P.O. Box 244, Troy, MI 48099. Proceeds benefit the campaign committee.
